options.description: Runs a line. The next prompt is drawn when it returns, or resolves.
options.name: onSubmit

options.description: Asks with plain lines in and lines out rather than a region that redraws, for a screen reader: the question is written once, what is typed is echoed where it is typed, and nothing already written is ever moved or erased.
options.name: accessible

options.description: What is on offer for the word at the caret.
options.name: completer

options.description: Where the line goes on from when it is cut at the end of a row. Defaults to `'... '`, which is `node`'s.
options.name: continuation

options.description: A line under the prompt, worked out from what is typed.
options.name: footer

options.description: Whether to list the keys under the line, as the prompts' footer does. Defaults to `false`.
options.name: help

options.description: Where earlier lines are kept. A `History` is shared with whoever else holds it; without one the REPL keeps its own in memory.
options.name: history

options.description: The file lines are kept in, shared with every REPL that names it. See `replHistoryFile()` for where an app's belongs. Without one, history lasts as long as this call.
options.name: historyFile

options.description: How many lines of history are kept. Defaults to 1,000.
options.name: historySize

options.description: Whether a line is not finished, so Enter starts another instead of submitting.
options.name: isContinued

options.description: How many completions the popup lists at once. Defaults to 8.
options.name: maxItems

options.description: Called with the line after every edit that changed it.
options.name: onChange

options.description: Called with what `completer` or an async `onSubmit` threw. Defaults to `console.error`, which an inline REPL writes above its region.
options.name: onError

options.description: What is drawn before the line. Defaults to `'> '`.
options.name: prompt

options.description: Ends the REPL, rejecting with the signal's reason, when it aborts.
options.name: signal

options.description: Where keys come from. Defaults to the terminal's input.
options.name: stdin

options.description: Whether the best completion is shown dim after the caret, for Right or End to accept. Defaults to `true`.
options.name: suggest

registryDescription: A REPL: a prompt line that comes back, with history, a completion popup anchored at the word, a dim suggestion and a footer
